entries.zh: 金精：金属所化之精怪（西语谓可被杀之鬼魅）
entries.en: metal spirit: a goblin or sprite of metal (glossed as a spirit that can be killed)
entries.notes: L 栏『duende a quien matan』为鬼怪义，与 H『金精』仅部分相合；H/M/R 三栏互证（jīn jīng）。

entries.zh: 蛇虫：蛇与虫豸，泛指爬虫毒虫
entries.en: snakes and other creeping things; reptiles and vermin
entries.notes: L 栏文字严重讹脱不可读，R 栏对音与 H 不合；据 H『蛇蟲』与 M『choā coù』定。

entries.zh: 嫂仔：女仆、佣妇；亦为对年长已婚妇女的称谓
entries.en: serving woman, maidservant; also a respectful address for an older married woman
entries.notes: L『Dueña de servicio』指服役之妇，与『嫂仔』作称谓语相合；R 栏对音讹脱。

entries.zh: 甘：味甜（与「甜」并列为甜味之训）
餳：麦芽或米熬成的糖、糖浆；亦指甜糕
entries.en: malt sugar, syrup; a sweet cake or sweetmeat

entries.zh: 万代公侯：世世代代承袭的公侯之位
entries.en: dukes and marquises for ten thousand generations; hereditary nobility in perpetuity

entries.zh: 倘：假如、倘若（与西语「durar 持续」不合，释义存疑）
entries.en: if, supposing (does not match the Spanish 'to last'; sense uncertain)
entries.notes: L『Durar algo』与 H『倘』、M『Còng』三者皆不合，疑为窜行或字形讹误。

entries.zh: 容：容纳；容忍、容受（或取「耐久」义）
entries.en: to hold, to contain; to bear, to endure
entries.notes: L『durar algo』与 H『容』不密合，权取「容受、耐久」义，存疑。

entries.zh: 坚固：牢固耐久，如经反复锤锻者
entries.en: very durable, solid, firm (as if hammered hard)

entries.zh: 目前光：眼前一闪之光，喻短暂易逝之物
entries.en: a glint of light before the eyes; something short-lived and fleeting
entries.notes: R 栏对音讹脱（amo chiem cuy），H/M 可读为『目前光』（ba̍k-chêng-kng）。

entries.zh: 金使（字面「以金使役」；与 L「持久并支撑」不合，疑为『禁使』或『堪使』之讹）
entries.en: golden envoy, to employ by means of gold (does not match the Spanish 'to last and sustain'; probably a misreading)
entries.notes: H 与 M『quím sày』音合但不成词，L 栏义亦不合，无法定夺。
L 栏作「Durazno… medicina」，西语词头与 H『杏』不尽合（桃、杏混列），故降等。

entries.zh: 仙桃：天上仙家之桃，传说食之长生
entries.en: peach of the immortals; the heavenly peach of longevity
